{{Top|leg}}
'''Rotation gears''' were [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] components. The gears required regular maintenance, ideally once a [[Standard week/Legends|week]].<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> Rotation gears were also part of the [[w-165 planetary turbolaser]]; the gears allowed the turbolaser to move its [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] to target enemies.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
